page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc5.large is an entry-tier compute-optimized virtual instance belonging to the High Clock Speed family. It provides two dedicated vCPUs derived from a single physical core with two threads on an Intel Xeon 6149 processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance features an x86_64 microarchitecture equipped with 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 22 MB shared L3 cache, alongside support for instruction sets including AVX-512F, AES-NI, BMI2, and FMA.

The hardware configuration pairs the two vCPUs with 4.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio typical of compute-oriented profiles. The instance includes no bundled local storage, necessitating external network-attached block storage for persistence and operating system disks. Network connectivity is bounded by a 1 Gbps baseline bandwidth ceiling, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

Benchmark results reflect the entry-level core count and legacy microarchitecture. In raw compute assessments, the server achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 1347.29 and a multi-core score of 1787.79, placing it in the bottom tiers compared to broader cloud standards. Geekbench testing mirrors these outcomes with a single-core score of 1064.0 and a multi-core rating of 1258.0. Uncached large-block memory bandwidth measures 10.2 GB/sec for reads and 9.66 GB/sec for writes. Workload-specific throughput reached 1.77 million operations per second in Redis SET routines and 1.4 GB/sec in static web serving.

Given its minimal core count, modest memory allocation, and lack of onboard storage, ecs.hfc5.large offers predictable execution via dedicated CPU pinning, though aggregate throughput is restricted. It is best applied to lightweight background processing, basic web serving, utility services, or staging environments with limited concurrency requirements.

The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached volumes, and network throughput is limited to a 1 Gbps baseline.
